    Universe lifting the ordinary quiver #

    The bound-quiver presentation bundle is universe-local. The ordinary quiver has a naturally small vertex type, so this file lifts its vertices into the coefficient-field universe without changing arrows, paths, or the free linear path category. The resulting reindexing functor is a linear equivalence.
